# Dorado Project

> Dorado Project is a genre-fluid music project. Tracks are inspired by ideas, journeys, people and moments rather than one fixed genre.

Official website: https://doradoproject.com/

## Releases and stories

- [Dorado Project](https://doradoproject.com/): official homepage and release overview.
- [CHAMONIX 2712](https://doradoproject.com/chamonix.html): the story and photo journal behind a pop/rock track inspired by a mountain trip to Chamonix and the Mont Blanc landscape.
